content.text:
Two production close sites, both on the same context-attached `*logging.Logger`:

1. **`cmd/entire/cli/root.go:108`** — `PersistentPostRun`, deferred so it flushes *after* the telemetry/version-check logging and even on the hidden-command early return.
2. **`cmd/entire/main.go:99-101`** — after `ExecuteContextC`, covering the paths Cobra skips `PersistentPostRun` on (arg-parse errors, `RunE` failures in some shapes). Guarded by a nil check.

The double-close is intentional — the comment at `root.go:105-107` calls it out, and `Logger.Close` (`cmd/entire/cli/logging/logger.go:143`) is idempotent and nil-safe: it sets `closed = true`, flushes/nils `buf`, closes/nils `file`, so a second call is a no-op returning the memoized `openErr`.

Nothing else in production code closes it. Everything else matching `Close()` near "log" is either unrelated (`doctor_logs.go` file handles, `tty`/`ptmx`, go-git `repo.Close()`) or test-only (`logging/logger_test.go`, `root_logging_test.go`, `resume_test.go`, `e2e/testutil/repo.go:166`).

- every path `PersistentPostRun` runs on, `main.go` also runs on (post-run finishes, then `Execute` returns);
